item.subject: maths
item.stem: The diagram shows Vedika's four-sided card, tilted on the page. Opposite sides are $5\,\mathrm{cm}$ and $3\,\mathrm{cm}$, and every corner is $90^\circ$.

parts.text: Which claim correctly names the figure?

options.text: A rectangle, because opposite sides are equal and all angles are $90^\circ$, even though the card is tilted.
A square, because any four-sided shape with right angles is called a square.
A rectangle, because the opposite sides are equal.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.
